sources.issuer: Ministry of Finance, Department of Revenue, CBIC
sources.title: Notification 10/2023-Central Tax
sources.interpretation_note: Effective 1 August 2023: five-crore threshold amendment. Apply with the base notification and published exclusion predicates. GSTIN-only turnover is not PAN history. Independently review applicability and later amendments.

sources.issuer: Ministry of Finance, Department of Revenue, CBIC
sources.title: Notification 78/2020-Central Tax
sources.interpretation_note: HSN digit basis is immediately preceding financial-year aggregate turnover, independent of the historical e-invoice predicate. This implementation does not classify goods or determine tax rates.

sources.interpretation_note: Treat 180-day generation and 360-day extension bounds as versioned portal controls, not statutory EWB applicability or authority-returned validity. Review active, held and superseding notices before publication.
